theme_rationale: A luxurious artisan bakery website needs a light, airy, elegant base (warm beige/off-white) to let the rich pinks and cake photography pop. High-contrast typography adds an editorial, magazine-like feel.

typography.rationale: Cormorant Garamond gives an ultra-premium, editorial, Awwwards-winning look for big kinetic typography. Manrope provides clean, geometric modernism for functional e-commerce UI.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-[7rem] tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Editorial Bento Grids, Asymmetry
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use CSS grid with subgrid where applicable. Break standard rows with overlapping images and text blocks. Avoid rigid boxes.

guidelines.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. The site must feel weighty and premium.
guidelines.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (initial y: 100%, clip-path).
guidelines.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero images using useScroll and useTransform from Framer Motion.
guidelines.interactions: Hover states should scale images slightly (scale-105) and transition colors smoothly.

components_strategy.forms: Use customized Shadcn UI components for Custom Cake Order Form. Strip standard borders, add bottom-borders only for a sleek editorial look.
components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. Hover should trigger a soft fill or text color inversion.
components_strategy.product_cards: Cardless design. Large image with text below. No background containers. Let the image be the star.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.description: Sticky Glassmorphism nav. Minimalist links. Primary CTA for 'Order Custom Cake'.

sections.name: Kinetic Hero
sections.description: Massive typographic hero saying 'Artisan Elegance'. Line-by-line text reveal. A hero image of a pink floral cake with a subtle parallax effect on scroll.

sections.name: Editorial Marquee
sections.description: Slow moving marquee with text 'CRAFTED IN PATHANKOT • CUSTOM CELEBRATIONS • AWARD WINNING BAKERY'.

sections.name: Numbered Manifesto (About)
sections.description: Chapters (01. The Craft, 02. The Ingredients, 03. The Occasion). Asymmetrical layout mixing typography and bakery interior/frosting shots.

sections.name: Product Collections (E-commerce)
sections.description: Grid of categories: Wedding, Birthday, Anniversary, Hampers. Hover over collection reveals a 'Shop Now' button following the cursor or appearing elegantly.

sections.name: Custom Cake Builder
sections.description: A sophisticated form section for custom orders. Flavor dropdown, size input, photo upload, and special message. Use Shadcn UI logic with custom styling.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.description: Minimalist text-based quotes fading in on scroll.

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Dark background. Huge 'US BAKERS' typography. Contact details for Pathankot. Payment methods displayed (COD, Razorpay).

image_urls.description: White and pink floral cake. Use for the main hero parallax.
Person piping frosting, great for the 'Craft' chapter.

universal_guidelines: 1. Do NOT use standard Shadcn card wrappers for e-commerce products. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for cardless, editorial layouts. 2. All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes. 3. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond. 4. Ensure accessibility (focus states, contrast). 5. Never use pure transparent backgrounds for sticky nav; always use a backdrop blur with semi-transparent color. 6. Avoid standard center-aligned Bootstrap layouts. Embrace asymmetry and generous whitespace (p-12, p-24). 7. Use specific transitions (`transition-transform`, `transition-colors`) instead of `transition-all`. 8. Include hover micro-interactions on all buttons and product images.
